name: What is the process for an accessibility bathroom renovation with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for an accessibility bathroom renovation with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific needs and assess your current bathroom. We then develop a detailed design plan and provide a comprehensive estimate. Once approved, we schedule the renovation work, manage all aspects of the project, and ensure the modifications are completed to the highest standards. We aim for clear communication throughout the entire process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, estimate, scheduling, and project completion with ongoing communication.
